describes: packages/plugin/actions: execute, policy, the tree walk, deferred effects, hide, executors, registration and hooks.

cases.name: incomplete-tree-is-refused
cases.covers: Never execute an incomplete tree, not even its root; canExecute agrees.

diagnostics.message: refused: the action tree is incomplete

cases.name: rootless-tree-is-inert
cases.covers: A tree with no root is inert and counted; canExecute is false.

cases.name: walks-next-in-pdf-order
cases.covers: Root then /Next depth-first, with the child-index path of every node.

cases.name: executed-then-failed-is-partial
cases.covers: An executed node beside a failed one folds to partial.

cases.name: defers-navigation-and-external-effects
cases.covers: goto, then javascript, then uri in PDF order: document work runs inline and the navigation and URI thunks fire after it, in node order.

cases.name: a-document-failure-drops-deferred-work
cases.covers: A failed document node skips later document nodes (javascript, reset-form, hide) and drops every deferred thunk; the result is partial.

cases.name: policy-matrix-defaults
cases.covers: The default rows: a lifecycle uri reports, a hover submit blocks, a lifecycle Print blocks, launch and the other fixed types are never executable, recognized types without an interpreter and unknown types are no-executor; canExecute mirrors the root decision.

cases.name: a-print-typed-node-uses-the-print-row
cases.covers: A node whose type is literally "print" finds policy.print by key, and with no executor is no-executor.

cases.name: policy-overrides
cases.covers: config.policy rows replace the defaults: block and report refuse with their names, allow executes even for a lifecycle uri.

cases.name: policy-rows-merge-and-update-live
cases.covers: config.policy merges row-wise over the defaults (a partial row keeps the other origins); getSettings returns the effective policy; updateSettings merges policy rows, and an empty settings patch preserves them for later dispatches.

cases.name: execute-named
cases.covers: executeNamed runs one Named verb as a user-origin api action through the same queue; a partial context overrides the origin, source or event; Print goes through the adapter door.

cases.name: get-action-tree
cases.covers: getActionTree reads the raw tree behind each source kind: an annotation (activate by default, or the named /AA event; the /A-shadows-U rule is not applied), a field by object number (not the first numbered field) or by name, a page (open by default or close), and the catalog (OpenAction by default, or the Table-200 tree for a verb). Anything absent is null; the required actions service returns an empty catalog for the second document.
cases.reason: Pins what the dispatcher answers: read trees, refusals, and which installed sink or resolver is current, through call outcomes, adapter callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: uri-without-an-adapter
cases.covers: A user uri with no adapter installed is no-executor with a no-adapter diagnostic.

cases.name: named-print-goes-to-the-adapter
cases.covers: The Named Print verb reaches the adapter with no context, never the named executor; other named verbs use the executor.

cases.name: print-refusals
cases.covers: Print with no adapter is no-executor; print without doc.print authority is blocked before the adapter.
cases.reason: Pins what the dispatcher answers: read trees, refusals, and which installed sink or resolver is current, through call outcomes, adapter callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: hide-routes-by-plane
cases.covers: A hide name resolves to its field (form setDisplay), a widget object number to its owning field, and a plain object number to an annotation flag patch; the form plane commits first.

cases.name: hide-and-later-document-work
cases.covers: An executed hide leaves later document nodes running; a failed hide skips them.

cases.name: hide-without-targets
cases.covers: A hide with no targets reads nothing and executes.

cases.name: hide-reports-honestly
cases.covers: Missing sinks are no-executor, an unresolved name is a diagnostic (the node still executes), an annotation refusal fails the node only when every entry failed, and a failure without an error string executes.

diagnostics.message: hide: no annotation commit sink registered (annotation plugin absent)
hide: no form commit sink registered (form plugin absent)

cases.name: hide-form-failures
cases.covers: A form sink failure (with an error message or without one) fails the node and skips the annotation plane.

cases.name: hide-sink-throws
cases.covers: A sink that throws synchronously inside hide is not caught by the dispatcher: execute rejects and nothing is counted.

cases.name: hide-forms-read-rejects
cases.covers: A forms.list rejection inside hide rejects execute.

cases.name: document-executors
cases.covers: reset-form and javascript without an executor (javascript is inert, "scripting unavailable"); an executor that is inert, fails, throws, rejects, or answers later.

cases.name: navigation-executors
cases.covers: Deferred goto/named: no executor, inert, throws, rejects, executed.

cases.name: executors-are-last-wins-and-identity-safe
cases.covers: A duplicate registration replaces the executor with a duplicate-executor diagnostic; a stale disposer leaves the successor; the current disposer removes it.

cases.name: adapter-is-identity-safe
cases.covers: A stale adapter disposer leaves the successor; the current one clears it; setUiAdapter(null) force-clears.

cases.name: sinks-and-resolver-are-identity-safe
cases.covers: Commit sinks, the submit resolver and the submit handler all install last-wins and clear only while current.
cases.reason: Pins what the dispatcher answers: read trees, refusals, and which installed sink or resolver is current, through call outcomes, adapter callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

diagnostics.message: hide: no annotation commit sink registered (annotation plugin absent)
submit-form: no dataset resolver registered (form plugin missing?)

cases.name: dispatches-serialize
cases.covers: One queue: a slow execute holds the next until it settles; both dispatch results settle in submission order.

cases.name: hooks-deliver-and-isolate
cases.covers: onExecuted carries source, tree and result; a throwing observer is reported to the kernel error sink and its siblings still run; an unsubscribed listener hears nothing.

cases.name: a-user-execute-arms-the-open-sequence
cases.covers: Under auto, a user-origin execute runs the open sequence ahead of itself; a hover execute does not arm it.
